OpenGL drivers and Mesa stacks on Linux hosts.
OpenGL via vendor ICDs on Windows (WGL).
Overlapping GPU graphics API problem space; Vulkan is the explicit low-overhead successor ecosystem (coexistence is common).
On Apple platforms, Metal is the supported low-overhead GPU path; legacy OpenGL exists but is deprecated for new development.
Overlapping GPU graphics API space on Windows; many titles and engines target Direct3D while OpenGL remains supported via ICDs.
WebGL is specified as a browser embedding of OpenGL ES-class APIs derived from the OpenGL family (Khronos).
OpenGL ES is the embedded/mobile profile of the OpenGL specification family (Khronos).
